হাতে তৈরিThe craft

Baked, not set

Misti doi is usually left to set overnight. Tanu bakes hers, slowly, in the same clay it's served in.

A note on nuts

Emerald Bliss contains pistachio, and all four flavours are made in a kitchen that handles nuts. If anyone at your table has a nut allergy, tell us before you order.

Traditional misti doi sets itself. Sweetened milk goes warm into an unglazed clay pot and is left overnight while the culture works. The clay does as much as the milk: it's porous, drawing the whey out through its walls, and that's where the thick texture and faint earthiness of a good one come from.

Tanu keeps the clay and the culture, and adds a slow, low bake. The milk is reduced first until it turns the colour of caramel, then baked in the pot at a gentle heat. The result is denser and silkier than a set doi, with a deeper caramel note. It's inspired by the comfort of mishti doi, in her words, rather than a copy of it.

Every batch is small, made in her kitchen in North Harrow and baked in the week it's delivered.

What's in the pot

Ingredients
Whole milk, cream, jaggery and a live yoghurt culture. In winter the jaggery is nolen gur, the date-palm sugar Bengal waits all year for. The flavoured pots add rose water and dried petals, pistachio, or Kashmiri saffron.
Allergens
Every flavour contains milk. Emerald Bliss contains pistachio, and all four are made in a kitchen that handles nuts, so no pot can be guaranteed nut-free. Each box carries a full ingredients label.
Diet
Vegetarian. No gelatine, no egg and no alcohol. Not suitable for vegans.
Keeping
Keep it in the fridge at 0–5°C and eat it within four days of delivery. Take it out ten minutes before serving; it's at its best just below room temperature.
The pot
Unglazed, food-safe terracotta, and yours to keep. Rinse it and plant something in it, or hand it back on your next delivery and we'll use it again.
Registration
Tanu's is registered as a food business with Harrow Council. Our food hygiene rating will be published here after our first inspection.
